ranker_model: haiku (fresh subagent per run, no tools, cards in a different order and with different letters each run)
rationale: Only three ideas. The bill list ranked last in all three runs, so it is the one clear gap. Journal and spend swap places across runs (1,1,2 against 2,2,1), a close call, so both survive. The ranker is a survey-style proxy for ad taps and favours emotional hooks over utility, so this kill is a weak signal about tap appeal and says nothing about the bill list's complaint evidence, which was the largest in the batch (12 complaints, 4 apps). Nothing here is demand evidence.
